title: pvSTEPReader
body:
## pvSTEPReader

Reads a STEP CAD file through OpenCASCADE and tessellates its B-rep faces into triangles, giving a multiblock dataset with one polydata block per shape (named from the file, or Unnamed) and a per-cell Colors array from the CAD colours. LinearDeflection and AngularDeflection set how closely the triangles follow curved surfaces; ReadWire adds edges as polylines. Use it to bring CAD geometry in for rendering, clipping or probing; use pvIGESReader for .iges, and readSTL or pvSTLReader for already-tessellated STL.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- VTK applies no unit conversion; compare the output bounds with the simulation's length unit before combining them.
- LinearDeflection is an absolute distance in model units unless RelativeDeflection is on; the default 0.1 can be very coarse for small parts, so scale it to the model size.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `STEPReader`. Identity: `sources/STEPReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AngularDeflection` | Limits the angle between two subsequent segments. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `LinearDeflection` | Limits the distance between a curve and the resulting tesselation. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ReadWire` | Determines if 1D cells will be read. If enabled, surface boundaries are read. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `RelativeDeflection` | Determines if the deflection values are relative to object size. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSTEPReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
